answer: Collateral is released only after a staggered maturity: 90 POA is locked for 11 epochs and unlocks in thirds, so a sockpuppet farm must fund every identity far ahead of any payout. Review duty rotates through a hollow drawn from the epoch beacon, and each reviewer bond of 25 POA is slashed if their verdicts are later overturned, aligning incentives. Identities also file a glacier ownership proof, and contradictions between two proofs void both. Because panels are re-drawn each epoch, marginal attacker cost compounds across spiral rather than staying flat.
